content: Benjamín Egipto-yarse selesad
Canaán-yargine bur bule ukud-dummad-naid gangumai gusad.
Degisoggu, Jacob, degi, e-masmala Egipto-yargi-orosgi-dakleged-senonimalad bergudanigu, Jacob e-masmalaga sogded: —Gannar Egipto-yarse bemar namar, anmarga orosgi-dakleged wis ichesaar be baknamar.
Ar Judá, e-bab-abin sogded: —Dummad-mas-dakmaid nue anmarga ise-sogar imaksad: ‘Be-urba-bipi bemar sedanisurmalale, bur melle be anse dagmaloye.’
Degisoggu, Benjamín be anmarba barmidele, anmar bega orosgi-dakleged baknaodo.
Ar be anmarba barmisulirdi, anmar bega baknaosurmodo. Ar dule anmarga sogsad: ‘Ar bemar be-urba-bipigwad anga sedasurmalale, bemar gwen an-dakosurmarye.’
Geb degine, Israel sogded: —¿Ibiga bemar sunnasur angi damala? ¿Ibiga bemar we-dulega sogsamala: ‘Anmar, urba-baid nikabarye?’

Masmala e-bab-abin sogdemalad: —Ar ade, dummad-mas-dakmaid anmarse nue-ibmar egichisad, degi, anmarse nue-anmar-gwenadgan egichisbalid. Anmarse egichisad: ‘¿Be-babde amba dula? ¿Bemar urba-baid nikamarbali?’ Ar anmarse ibmar-egisnaidbi ega an sogsamalad. Ar igi anmar wisguosunna, weyob anmarse egisdagoed: ‘Be-urba be anga sedamaloye.’ Anmar wissurdo.

Judá e-bab-Israelʼga sogded: —Ar anmar ukudba burgwebisurmalale, Benjamín be anmarba barmiddo. Ani, an bega dakoed. Eyeye be sogele, anmar yog-naar imakoed. Ar deyob be imakele, geb anmar, be, degi, anmar-mimmigan burgosurmalad.
Be-machi-an-sedoedi, angi siido. Ar machigwa igi-gusdibe, an-nukindo. Ar wese gannar an bega senonisulile, an-burgwedse angi ataklegodo.
Weyob anmar yoggunaisulina, ¡bato ilabogus anmar Egipto-yarse arbi-wilubbinad!

Geb degine, e-bab-Israel Judá-abin sogded: —Ar geg an oakalosoggu, ar weyob bemar imakmarsundo. Be-sagu-yaba macheredga binsa ibmar-ukega be sedmar. Bemar-ibmar-sedoedi, bur-ibmar-nuegan-we-yargi-nikad ega be sedmalo:
Deginbali, mani-ilabo-mergu be sedmarbalo. Ar abakalegi, emar bemarga mani-uksadi wis noar-odosale, a-mani bemar-sunnad ega be gannar ukmalo.
¡Be namar! Be-urba be sedmar. Dummad-mas-dakmaidse gannar be namar.

Bab-Dummad-Bela-Gangued-Nikad wile be-dakmalana gadin, adi, be-gwenad-galesiid onogegar, degine, Benjamín nabir gannar barmidabaligar. Andi, machimala-sate an gudele, igi an barsaosunna, machimala-sate an guodo.
Jacob-machimala Egiptoʼgi-dummadga-maidga ibmar-binsa-ukdapmaloed sesmalad. Mani-ilabo-bur-bule-mergu sesmalad, degi, Benjamín-sesmarbalid. Geb degine, Egipto-yarse nadmarsunnad.

Joséʼse modapmargu, José dakded, Benjamín e-iamarba nonimoga. Geb José ega-neg-akwedga sogded: “We-dulemar an-negse be sede. Moli-bebe-nikad-wargwen be oburgo. Mas-sao, ar ade, we-dulemar emi yoruku anba mas gunmaloed.”
Ar Joséʼga-neg-akwed José-ega-sogsadyob imaksad, e-sunnad José-e-gwenadgan-sesad.

Agine, José-e-gwenadgan José-negse selemamaigu, dobe-itonadmalad, sogdemalad: “Iduar anmar-sagu-yaba mani-urbismalad-ular, yamo e-negse anmar-semaid. ”Wese anmar-senonikid, adi, sabsur-anmar-odurdakega, e-maiga anmar-imakega, degine, anmar-moli-uayasuidmar anmar-ibe suegar.”
Degisoggu, José-neg-yawagak-mosmargu, Joséʼga-neg-akwedbo-sunmakmalagala ese walikaa nadmalad.
Geb Joséʼga-neg-akwedga sogdemalad: —¡Dummad! Iduale, anmar orosgi-dakleged-bakega arbimalad.
Gannar anmar nadedgi, neg-gaboedse anmar modapgu, anmar sagu egad-egad-egadmargu, anmar-sagu-yaba, bela-sogedba anmar-mani-senonikid bukwa dakalid. Emigi, a-mani bega-ukega anmar sedanikid.
Ar anmar wissulid, iduale doa anmar-sagu-yaba mani urbisa. Deginbali, orosgi-dakleged-bakega anmar mani sedanibalid.

Joséʼga-neg-akwed abin-sogded: —Mer be bukib-binsamar, mer be dobgumar. Ar bemar-Bab-Dummad, be-bab-e-Bab-Dummad, a bemar-sagu-yaba mani-urbisargebed. Ar ade, bemar-mas-baksad-mani anga uklesad. Joséʼga-neg-akwed Simeón-esgaryagi-mellesiid onosad. Geb degi, e-gwenadgan-bukwadse sesad.
Geb degine, Joséʼga-neg-akwed bela negyaba José-e-gwenadgan-odosad. Geb ega dii uksad, adi, na nag enukmalagar. Deginbali, e-moli-uayasuidmarga mas uksabalid.
José-e-iamar guakwaa Joséʼga-ibmar-ukmaloed urbismalad. José-yorukudba-nonikoedi edarbesigismalad. Ar ade, wisgusmalad, emarde agi mas gunmaloye.
José e-negse-nonigu, e-iamar ega ibmar-ukega-senonikid ukdemalad, bela José-abin dulluu e-bebe napase ebulegedse imakdemalad.
Geb degine, José egisded: —Bemarde nueganbimar sogeye. José egisdebalid: —Degite, be-babde, be-anga-egi-sunmaksamalad, nue-selebagusye, ¿amba dula gudii? ¿Nued gudii?
José-e-iamar bela napase dulluu José-abin imakdemalad. Geb degine, ega sogdemalad: —Anmar-bab, be-mai, nued gudii. Amba dula gudii.

José bela dulemar-dakdegu, dakalid, e-urba-galagwenad-Benjamín simoga. Geb degine, José sogded: —¿We, bemar-urba-bipigwad bemar anga egi sunmaksamaladi? Geb degine, José, Benjamínʼga sogded: —¡Machi, Bab-Dummad ise-nued begi binsaena gadin!
José weyob sogsagua, e-urba-dakedba bela-bela ulubgi-yeer-itoged, geb bela-bela bobi gualid. Degidbali, José gwae-gwae e-gabedyaba dogsad. Agi, nue-bosii gusad.
José bosiid na bargasgu, e-wagar-enuksagu, noalid. Geb degine, sogded: “¡Mas wemar!”

Joséʼga mese-gwagwengi mas ega urbismalad. Jacob-e-masmalagardi baid-mesegi, degine, Egipto-dulemar-eba-mas-gunmaladga baid-mesegi urbismarmogad. Ar ade, Egipto-dulemar Hebreo-dulemarbo geg mas gunned, ega ised-dummad gued.
José e-gwenadganga igar-uksagu, mese-naba e-serguedba sigismalad, dummad-inse, geb bipigwadse. Agala, bela geger-dakmalad, muchub-muchub, nuu-nuu dakbukwa guarmalad.
José e-mesegi-mas-bukwad e-iamarga uksad. Benjamínʼgardi bur bule ilatar-mergu uksad. José, e-gwenadganmala gobsamalad, weligwar itosmalad.
